targets.rawSql: SELECT count() as requests FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent'
SELECT count() as tool_calls FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool'

SELECT 1 - countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0) as tool_success FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool'
$increase(Value) FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost'

SELECT 1 - countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0) as success_rate FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent'

SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] as provider, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix) as cost FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost' AND Attributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '' GROUP BY provider ORDER BY cost DESC

SELECT $timeSeries as t, count() as requests FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT $timeSeries as t, sum(Sum) as tokens FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT sum(Sum) / nullIf(sum(Count), 0) as avg_input FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' AND Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'input'

SELECT sum(Sum) / nullIf(sum(Count), 0) as avg_output FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' AND Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'output'

panels.title: Cost per 1K Tokens
panels.description: Total cost normalized per 1,000 tokens consumed

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.total_cost / nullIf(t.total_tokens, 0) * 1000 as cost_per_1k FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix) as total_cost FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost') c, (SELECT sum(Sum) as total_tokens FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage') t

SELECT c.total_cost / nullIf(r.requests, 0) as avg_cost FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix) as total_cost FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost') c, (SELECT count() as requests FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent') r

panels.title: Input vs Output Tokens by Model

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.model, a.input_tokens, b.output_tokens FROM (SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, sum(Sum) as input_tokens FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' AND Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'input' AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != '' GROUP BY model) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, sum(Sum) as output_tokens FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' AND Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'output' AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != '' GROUP BY model) b ON a.model = b.model ORDER BY a.input_tokens DESC

SELECT t.model, t.avg_input, t.avg_output, c.cost_per_req FROM (SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, sum(Sum) / nullIf(sum(Count), 0) as avg_input, sumIf(Sum, Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'output') / nullIf(sumIf(Count, Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'output'), 0) as avg_output FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != '' GROUP BY model) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, (argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix)) / nullIf(sum(Count), 0) as cost_per_req FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost' AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != '' GROUP BY model) c ON t.model = c.model ORDER BY t.avg_input DESC

SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, count() as total_requests, avg(Duration / 1000000000) as avg_latency_s, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0) as error_rate FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'chat' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != '' GROUP BY model ORDER BY total_requests DESC

$columns(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, avg(Duration / 1000000000) as avg_s) FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'chat' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != '' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t

panels.title: Token Usage by Model Over Time

targets.rawSql: $columns(Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, sum(Sum) as tokens) FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != '' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t

panels.title: Where Time Goes (Avg Request)
panels.description: Average time spent in each operation as a percentage of the request

targets.rawSql: SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] as operation, avg(Duration / 1000000000) as avg_s FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ('chat', 'execute_tool', 'retrieval') GROUP BY operation ORDER BY avg_s DESC

$columns(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] as operation, avg(Duration / 1000000000) as avg_s) FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ('chat', 'execute_tool', 'retrieval') GROUP BY t, operation ORDER BY t

SELECT $timeSeries as t, avg(Duration / 1000000000) as llm_time FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'chat' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT $timeSeries as t, avg(Duration / 1000000000) as request_time FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] as operation, quantile(0.5)(Duration / 1000000000) as p50, quantile(0.9)(Duration / 1000000000) as p90, quantile(0.99)(Duration / 1000000000) as p99 FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ('invoke_agent', 'chat', 'execute_tool', 'retrieval') GROUP BY operation ORDER BY p50 DESC

SELECT c.total_cost / nullIf(r.requests, 0) as cost_per_request FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix) as total_cost FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost') c, (SELECT count() as requests FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent') r
SELECT avg(Duration / 1000000000) as avg_request_s FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent'

SELECT tc.tool_calls / nullIf(r.requests, 0) as tools_per_request FROM (SELECT count() as tool_calls FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool') tc, (SELECT count() as requests FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent') r

SELECT avg(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['app.retrieval.chunk_count'])) as avg_chunks FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'retrieval' AND SpanAttributes['app.retrieval.chunk_count'] != ''

SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] as tool, count() as calls, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') as errors, avg(Duration / 1000000) as avg_duration_ms FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] != '' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC
